games.name: FIGURE'S LIBRARY 📚
games.desc:
A game where you can practice the DOORS library without going through 50 rooms.

After taking a random elevator, you find yourself locked inside a library with raw meat!

This game uses assets & ideas from DOORS by LSPLASH. All credit goes to the LSPLASH team.

games.name: Subterra ⛏️ [BETA]
games.desc:
Welcome to Subterra ⛏️! 
It's a 2.5 dimensional mining game with a procedurally generated world where you dig deeper, upgrade your pickaxe and survive layers that get more hostile the further you descend.

❓ [ How to Play ]
- Mine ores and upgrade your pickaxe to go even deeper.
- Build your character with Ability Cards.
- Craft Weapons that help you defeat monsters.
- Obtain rare recipes of weapons and potions.
- Explore various layers.
- Defeat Monsters and Bosses!

💻 [ Controls ]
- E to open Inventory
- C to Interact
- F to Block/Parry
- Left Mouse to Mine

💾 [BETA] 
The game is still under development, expect various changes. 
If you find bugs or have suggestions let us know in the community server!

Thank you for playing!

games.name: Egg Toss [2 Players]
games.desc:
👍 LIKE the game and join the group to get Free Fossil Egg!
🥚 Don't let your team's egg fall short or overshoot the catch.

How to play: 
- Pair up with your friend and choose your team.
- Toss and catch the egg to keep your team in the game.
- Distance between the pair gets farther with each successful catch.

⭐ 2 Game Modes to have fun
Classic - Start with one egg only. The last team with an unbroken egg wins!
Survival -  Get a new egg every round and outlast deadly lava. The last team standing wins!

🔥 Earn wins to unlock egg skins and climb the leaderboard!

games.name: D.I.G.
games.desc:
DIG IS IN BETA; Expect bugs and balancing issues. Thank you for your support. Join the community server to report bugs.

Hover Mouse over UI in bottom left corner to see tool controls.
B - Quick Chat

DIG is a sandbox shooter inspired by classic Roblox games!! Each match takes place throughout a valley whereby the goal is to capture the other team's base by fully lowering their flag.

Use your shovel tool to dig trenches and fortify your base/FOB.
Get utility and weapons from the radio to assist in your battle.
Take victory swiftly, stockpiles only have enough food for 3 days of fighting.

Inspired by Foxhole, Trenches (Pordier at War), Underground War, Something Evil Will Happen, The W, and Dream Dive.
